title: Argo Workflows Workflow Workflow Duration p95
app: Argo Workflows controller logs and the Argo API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=argo:workflow phase="Succeeded"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_s/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by workflow_template
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile workflow duration for each workflow in Argo Workflows and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Argo Workflows workflows by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Argo Workflows timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest workflows with their owners.
visualization: Table of workflow by p95 workflow duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Argo Workflows so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
